subject.title: Telegram: /commands in forum topics bypass groupPolicy disabled and trigger all bots

question: Should Telegram native commands use topic/group `groupPolicy` overrides and silently drop commands when the effective policy is disabled, with this repair handled separately from the open `/models` callback PR?
rationale: This is an authorization-boundary bug, and the previous one-line fix PR was closed because it made disabled-topic commands reach a visible denial branch rather than proving the non-owning bot ignore behavior.

options.title: Repair Native Commands Separately
options.body: Fix the native slash-command authorization path to honor topic/group policy overrides and silently drop disabled-topic commands, then validate with focused tests and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Fold Into Callback Auth Work
options.body: Ask the callback PR owner to expand scope to native commands too, accepting a larger mixed authorization change before merge.

options.title: Keep Visible Denials
options.body: Allow disabled-topic command attempts to emit denial replies, which is simpler but does not match the multi-bot isolation expectation in this report.

recommendation.title: Repair Native Commands Separately
recommendation.body: Fix the native slash-command authorization path to honor topic/group policy overrides and silently drop disabled-topic commands, then validate with focused tests and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc recently changed native command authorization and group-auth tests in the affected path, making them the best available routing candidate for the security-boundary choice.
